verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents exporting its rendered output: 4K video export on paid plans and SCORM export (an open e-learning standard) for LMS use. That lets a user take finished videos with them, but nothing in the evidence shows a bulk account-data export or portability of the other assets a user builds up (scripts, projects, avatars, voice clones, brand kit). Missing for 10: full account/data export tooling, export of avatars, voices, scripts and project files in open formats, documented offboarding or data-portability process, and independent corroboration.
